role_grants_single_scope.name: role_grants_single_scope

projects_dates_ck.name: projects_dates_ck

recurring_cadence_fields_ck.name: recurring_cadence_fields_ck

rules_approved_meta_ck.name: rules_approved_meta_ck

authorities_verified_has_reviewer_ck.name: authorities_verified_has_reviewer_ck
authorities_verified_has_reviewer_ck.value: "professional_authorities"."status" <> 'VERIFIED' or ("professional_authorities"."verified_by" is not null and "professional_authorities"."verified_at" is not null)

enrollments_approved_dates_ck.name: enrollments_approved_dates_ck
